description.value: Mary Brown's Chicken is a 100% Canadian-owned fast food chain founded in 1969 in St. John's, Newfoundland, now operating nearly 300 locations coast to coast. The chain is known for hand-cut, hand-breaded fresh chicken and hand-prepared taters made from whole Canadian-grown potatoes. This Victoria location (unit 120) offers a familiar, filling stop for touring cyclists looking for a hot meal.
